Class OmieCategoryProvider

Namespace
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.Services
Assembly
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.dll

Resolves the category (cCodCateg) a service order carries in Omie. Omie requires the category on inclusion and every account has its own chart of accounts — which is why it is discovered in the registration instead of hardcoded: the categories are listed and the first of the configured preferences is picked by name.

Only accounts that can take a revenue entry are considered: conta_receita = "S", active, not a totalizer (totalizers are just groupings of the chart of accounts) and not a transfer account. Filtering by name alone could land on an expense account with a similar name.

GetRevenueCategoriesAsync(bool, CancellationToken)

Usable revenue categories of the chart of accounts — the list an application offers for selection. With forceRefresh the cache is ignored and rewritten with whatever Omie returns, which is what a "reload from the ERP" action needs: without it the button would serve the cached list for the next 30 minutes and look like it did nothing.

ResolveCategoryCodeAsync(string?, IReadOnlyList<string>, CancellationToken)

Category code for the service order. configuredCode wins when informed — whoever configured it knows which account they want. Without it, the preferences are searched in order.
